name: 01-portrait-inline
eval: (function(){ var im=document.getElementById('dlg-img'); return JSON.stringify({complete:im.complete, nw:im.naturalWidth, nh:im.naturalHeight, len:im.src.length}); })()

name: 02-portrait-canvas-pixels
eval: (function(){ var im=document.getElementById('dlg-img'); if(!im.naturalWidth) return 'NO-PIXELS(nw=0)'; var c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=im.naturalWidth; c.height=im.naturalHeight; var g=c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(im,0,0); var d=g.getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data; var u=new Set(), n=0, sum=0; for(var i=0;i<d.length;i+=40){ u.add((d[i]>>4<<8)|(d[i+1]>>4<<4)|(d[i+2]>>4)); sum+=d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2]; n++; } return JSON.stringify({size:im.naturalWidth+'x'+im.naturalHeight, sampled:n, distinctColors:u.size, avgBrightness:Math.round(sum/(n*3))}); })()
